note: Wikimedia Commons, “Огњена Марија убија демона тољагом1.jpg”; artist as recorded there: Apetkovic01 — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons' description reads «Света Великомученица Марина» — the Holy Great-martyr Marina — and the picture shows her striking the demon with a mallet, the scene proper to the Antioch great-martyr. The rank great-martyr is this folder's and separates her from Marina the Monk of Alexandria, who is venerable and not a martyr. Commons describes it: Света Великомученица Марина
